title: Splitting a billable work order keeps its prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with two labor lines of 2.0 hours each.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Split work order 1, moving its second line to a new work order.
  3. Open the new work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens; its second line shows $240.00 (2.0 h × $120.00).

Step 2:

  • A new work order is created.

Step 3:

  • The moved line shows $240.00, as it did in step 1, and no badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-E2: “If a work order is split, each part keeps the classification of the original and, on a no-charge work order, its category; the new work order starts with Shop supplies $0.00 and gets no automatic fees or discounts (S2-R15); lines move with cost and hours and no prices.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Regular work orders, invoicing, payments, discounts, credits and the customer portal behave exactly as they do today.”
